name: Portable Manual Ice Shaver  | Snow Cone & Slush Maker | Stainless Steel Blades | Ice Shaving Machine for Home, Kitchen & Camping
description:
Prepare refreshing cold drinks, snow cones, slushies, and shaved ice desserts with this Portable Manual Ice Shaver Crusher. Designed for effortless hand-operated ice crushing, this compact ice shaver features durable stainless steel blades that quickly transform ice cubes into fine or coarse ice without the need for electricity. Its ergonomic hand-crank design, non-slip base, and portable construction make it ideal for home kitchens, outdoor gatherings, camping trips, and family parties. Easy to use, clean, and store, it's the perfect kitchen tool for creating delicious frozen treats anytime.

Key Features
Manual hand-crank ice shaver for effortless ice crushing
Sharp stainless steel blades for fast and efficient shaving
Produces fine shaved ice or coarse crushed ice
No electricity required for convenient use anywhere
Ergonomic handle for smooth and comfortable operation
Stable non-slip base for secure use
Compact and lightweight portable design
Ideal for snow cones, slushies, cold drinks, and desserts
Easy to clean and maintain
Perfect for home, kitchen, parties, picnics, and camping

Product Type: Manual Ice Shaver Crusher
Operation: Hand-Crank Manual

Suitable For: Ice Cubes, Snow Cones & Frozen Desserts

How to Use
Open the lid and place ice cubes inside
Close the lid securely
Rotate the hand crank to shave the ice
Collect the shaved ice in the container below
Add syrups or toppings as desired and enjoy

Material / Composition
Food-Grade ABS Plastic
Stainless Steel Blades
Non-Slip Base Components
